m01_static_mu.purpose: Replace only the first two generic demonstrations with verified training62 joint-constraint island and47 institutional-role chain; no additional rules.

m02_adaptive_mu.purpose: Same instruction and last three examples as m01; select first two from72 reviewed Mu training examples by fixed BM25 word+bigram similarity. No dataset metadata used for selection.

screen.macro: Unweighted mean of three dataset pass rates; raw90 is Mu-enriched, not comparable to old balanced samples.
screen.candidate_gate: MuSiQue passes strictly exceed baseline, macro pass rate exceeds baseline, and combined Hotpot+2Wiki regress by at most1 net pass.
screen.selection: Eligible candidate with highest Mu pass count, then macro pass rate, then lower mean input tokens; otherwise retain baseline and do not run confirmation.

confirmation.gate: One selected candidate vs baseline once on120 balanced queries. Require higher total pass count AND higher Mu pass count; otherwise no promotion. Report dataset regressions and uncertainty.

review: Unchanged F/S/C/U, current Codex nonindependent query/output review; lock baseline judgments before reading candidate outputs. Identical arrays inherit judgments. All failures/uncertainty remain in denominator.
record_every_payload: Full actual prompt, selected example IDs, scores, raw output, native tokens, runtime, checkpoint identity.
test_uses: Old formal300 and prior confirmation90 are diagnostic history only; neither selects these candidates. New confirmation outputs cannot drive further edits in this iteration.
